## Checklist (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Focused change with tests, including realistic negative cases
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` and `python -m security_runner skills validate skills` pass
- [ ] `python scripts/check_links.py` and `python scripts/check_public_mit.py .` pass
- [ ] Default behavior stays offline and safe; no active testing added
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated; limitations stated honestly
- [ ] Changes to confidence, profiles, CI gating or accuracy numbers are explained with measurements
- [ ] No secrets, third-party checklist text or unreviewed external content
- [ ] I license this contribution under the MIT License
